words.meaning: An overwhelming feeling of great happiness or joyful excitement.
words.sentence1: She closed her eyes in pure ecstasy as the symphony reached its soaring climax. (She closed her eyes in pure ecstasy as the symphony reached its soaring climax.)
words.sentence2: The team danced on the field in a state of wild ecstasy after winning the championship. (The team danced on the field in a state of wild ecstasy after winning the championship.)

words.sentence1: El anuncio del festival trajo gran regocijo a toda la comunidad local. (The announcement of the festival brought great joy to the entire local community.)
words.sentence2: Sus rostros se iluminaron con un profundo regocijo al ver a sus nietos. (Their faces lit up with deep delight upon seeing their grandchildren.)

words.meaning: A state of well-being and contentment; happiness.
words.sentence1: Le bonheur se trouve souvent dans les choses les plus simples de la vie quotidienne. (Happiness is often found in the simplest things of daily life.)
words.sentence2: Il a pleuré de bonheur en recevant la magnifique nouvelle de sa promotion. (He cried with happiness upon receiving the wonderful news of his promotion.)

words.sentence1: Ein Gefühl tiefer Glueckseligkeit erfüllte ihn, als er den Berggipfel erreichte. (A feeling of deep bliss filled him when he reached the mountain peak.)
words.sentence2: Sie schaute ihn mit einer solchen Glueckseligkeit an, dass Worte überflüssig waren. (She looked at him with such bliss that words were superfluous.)

words.sentence1: Kanojo wa kazoku to sugosu jikan ni hontou no koufuku o kanjiteiru. (She feels true happiness in the time spent with her family.)
words.sentence2: Minna ga heiwa de koufuku na seikatsu o okureru koto o negatteimasu. (I hope everyone can lead a peaceful and happy life.)

words.sentence1: La notizia della vittoria ha scatenato un grande giubilo in tutta la città. (The news of the victory unleashed great jubilation throughout the city.)
words.sentence2: I bambini saltavano di giubilo quando hanno saputo che la scuola era chiusa. (The children jumped for joy when they learned school was closed.)

words.sentence1: Zhu ni shengri kuaile, xiangshou zhege meihao de rizi. (Wishing you a happy birthday, enjoy this wonderful day.)
words.sentence2: Kan dao haizimen de xiao lian, ta de xinli chongman le kuaile. (Seeing the children's smiling faces, his heart was filled with joy.)

words.sentence1: I gin chukje deui gippeum eul modugamkke nanugo sipda. (I want to share the joy of this long festival with everyone.)
words.sentence2: Aideul ui malkeun useum sori ga naege keun gippeum eul jumida. (The clear laughter of the children gives me great joy.)

words.sentence1: Knhom ban sosabay pit nas del ban trajuob knea phg mteang tiet. (I am truly happy to meet each other again.)
words.sentence2: Komnap-lkanh chbuh nis leu-k-teung kar sok-sabay knong trov-kru sa-ne. (This poem reflects happiness within a loving family.)

words.sentence1: Om na 'n lang week in die stil natuur te sit is pure saligheid. (Sitting in the quiet nature after a long week is pure bliss.)
words.sentence2: Sy glimlag het 'n diep gevoel van saligheid in sy hart weerspieël. (Her smile reflected a deep feeling of bliss in his heart.)
